name: MediaInfo
author: MediaArea.net SARL
summary: A convenient unified display of the most relevant technical and tag data for video and audio files.

MediaInfoLib source code has been audited by several security researchers and private individuals.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
